Method of Attack: Malicious ZIP archive containing two distinct archive structures with two EOCD records to bypass secure email gateways
Decoy harmless image file in first ZIP structure and malicious NanoCore RAT executable in second ZIP structure
Bypassing secure email gateways by exploiting differences in ZIP extraction behavior of various file extractors
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (due to ZIP extraction behavior)
Attack Vector: Phishing email with specially crafted ZIP attachment
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of two EOCD records in ZIP archive
